title: Barehand Fish Catch
description: Time your lightning-fast grab in crystal-clear river streams to catch darting trout, crabs, and golden koi barehanded for massive combo hauls.
controls: Tap at the exact moment a fish swims into your reach zone to snatch it cleanly from the stream.

zh-CN.title: 徒手抓鱼
zh-CN.description: 魔性手速解压徒手抓鱼：盯紧溪水里游来游去的肥鱼与锦鲤，瞅准时机快准狠一把抓起爽感爆棚！
zh-CN.controls: 看准游鱼进入抓捕区域的瞬间迅速点击出手，连抓稀有大鱼冲击高分。
